Lead Machine Learning Engineer  

Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
About the job
Senior AI & ML Egnineer Lead

Amsterdam, Netherlands

Up to €140k total package 



This is a senior leadership role for someone who wants to shape how AI and machine learning are applied at scale across a high‑impact consumer platform. You will define strategy, influence product direction, and lead teams building production‑grade ML and generative AI solutions that directly affect millions of users.



The Company

They are a well‑established digital platform operating at significant scale, with data and technology at the core of their product strategy. AI and machine learning are central to how they improve user experience, relevance, and efficiency. The organisation values pragmatic innovation, strong engineering standards, and collaboration between product, data, and engineering teams.



The Role

Lead and develop a team of data scientists embedded within product teams
Set and own the ML and AI strategy, aligning technical direction with long‑term product and business goals
Champion an AI‑first approach, identifying where traditional ML, generative AI, or hybrid solutions deliver the most value
Oversee the full lifecycle of ML and AI systems, from experimentation to reliable production deployment
Drive high standards in model evaluation, MLOps, and engineering best practices
Make informed build‑versus‑buy decisions for models, platforms, and third‑party tools
Act as a senior partner to product, engineering, and business stakeholders


Your Skills & Experience

Strong commercial experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production
Deep understanding of core ML concepts and modern AI techniques, including generative AI and large language models
Experience leading or mentoring data science or ML teams in a product‑driven environment
Strategic mindset, with the ability to connect technical decisions to business impact
Confidence influencing senior stakeholders and making decisions with imperfect information
Solid knowledge of modern data stacks, MLOps, and scalable ML architectures


What They Offer

Competitive base salary with performance‑related bonus
High‑impact role with clear ownership and strategic influence
Strong emphasis on learning, experimentation, and technical excellence
Collaborative culture with real investment in data and AI capability


How to Apply

If you are looking to lead AI and ML at scale and shape the direction of a major consumer platform, apply now to find out more.
